sentences.text: Rejoinder affidavit filed on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Abhay Pratap Singh,Sr. Advocate, learned counsel for the complainant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

3. This anticipatory bail application has been moved on behalf of the applicant Antish Kumar, who is involved in Case Crime No.0085 of 2024, under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 120-B, 304-B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.- Colonelganj, District- Prayagraj.

4. As per prosecution story, informant solemnized marriage of her daughter with Madhav on 15.4.2022 as per Hindu Rites and Rituals but her husband and other in-laws were not happy with Antish Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 31 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121481936/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 the dowry given and they started demanding big car.
It is alleged that on 14.25.2024, the informant came to know through phone that his daughter was killed by hanging.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated only because he was the husband of the deceased.
No dowry has been demanded by the applicant.
There is no injury of physical assault was found on the body of the deceased.
As per post-mortem report, cause of death is Ashypxia due to ante mortem hanging.
Several other submissions in order to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against the applicant have also been placed forth before the Court.
The circumstances which, according to the counsel, led to the false implication of the accused have also been touched upon at length.
It has been assured on behalf of the applicant that he is ready to cooperate with the process of law and shall faithfully make himself available before the court whenever required.

6. Learned counsel for the informant as well as learned A.G.A. have vehemently opposed the prayer and submitted that victim died within 7 years of marriage, applicant is husband, and there is specific assertion of cruelty on account of non fulfillment of dowry demand, therefore, keeping in view the seriousness of the allegations made against the applicant, the applicant is not entitled to grant of anticipatory bail.
Learned counsel for the informant further submits that charge-sheet has already submitted against the applicant, therefore, no case for anticipatory bail is made out.
7. From the perusal of material on record and looking into the facts of the case at this stage it cannot be said that no offence is made out against the applicant.

8. After having very carefully examined, the submissions made by the learned counsel for the applicant and perused the material brought on record and from the perusal of record, it prima facie appears that the death had taken place within 7 years of marriage; that it was a death otherwise than normal circumstances; that the lady was subjected to cruelty in connection with the demand of dowry, therefore, all the ingredients of Section 304-B I.P.C. are prima facie available on the record against the applicant, there is no justification for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail is hereby refused.
9. Accordingly, the instant anticipatory bail application is rejected.

Order Date :- 31.5.2024 S.A.
